meta.parties: Walker, Sons & Co., Ltd. v. Kandyan

rules.statement: Actions for work and labour done and goods sold and delivered, though these are unwritten contracts, come within section 9 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "However this may be, there are one or two matters which in any case appear to enable the plaintiffs to avoid the plea of prescription. The plaintiffs' bill against the defendant was for Rs. 2,268.95, and the claim, with the addition of certain other charges, has now amounted to Rs. 2,677.42. When the plaintiffs pressed for payment, the defendant replied by letter and acknowledged his indebtedness, and promised to pay Rs. 2,000 in full satisfaction."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 9 of the Prescription Ordinance, which refers to actions for or in respect of work and labour or goods sold and delivered.
